artworks.title: The Troops Forcing the Gate of a Town
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 29.6 cm (8 3/4 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork shows warriors clad in armor engaged in combat, wielding swords and bows. A gate and a wall are depicted on the left side. Archers are shooting arrows, and soldiers are in close combat. More warriors are advancing in formation in the background, with ships visible in the distance. The use of lines and shading creates a dynamic and detailed appearance, capturing the chaos and movement of a battle.

artworks.title: The Second Naval Battle
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19 × 29.5 cm (7 1/2 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: There is a detailed monochromatic image depicting a naval battle at sea. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing tall ships with masts, sails, and intricate rigging in action. Smoke billows from some ships. The horizon is low in the composition, where the sea meets the sky. The style features detailed lines emphasizing the ships' movement. In the background, dynamic cloud patterns fill the sky.

artworks.title: Assault on the Outer Forts of Bone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 29.5 cm (7 7/8 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The scene depicts figures engaged in combat using weapons such as swords, spears, and shields. One group is wearing helmets and armor, while the other group is clad in draped robes and some wear turbans. In the background, there is a fortified structure with smoke rising. The illustration captures the intensity and movement of the clash.

artworks.title: Taking of Bone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 × 29.6 cm (8 3/4 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient military siege. The scene features a group of armored warriors on a hill preparing to attack a fortified city. Some soldiers are scaling ladders against the walls, and a battle is happening on various fronts, including an approach from the sea with ships in the background. The intricate detailing of the scene showcases skill in rendering human figures and architectural elements, highlighting the intensity and action of the military event. The drawing has a dramatic composition, capturing the tension and movement of the siege.

artworks.title: Assault on Two Fortresses
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 29.4 cm (8 3/4 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a historical battle scene featuring soldiers in siege warfare. They are seen advancing towards fortified walls with ladders, firing muskets. In the foreground, a figure in armor is directing the troops towards the battle. The soldiers wear armor, helmets with plumes, and carry weapons like muskets and pikes. Ships are visible in the background, suggesting naval forces may be involved. The drawing captures the chaos and coordination of the military operation with detailed line work, typical of engravings depicting historical events.

artworks.title: Crowning of the Grand Duchess
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.3 × 30.7 cm (9 3/16 × 12 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal ceremony in which a figure is being crowned. The drawing depicts an elaborate scene with numerous figures gathered under a decorative canopy. Horses are present on either side of the composition, ridden by figures in heavy clothing and bearing weapons. The central figure is depicted bowing slightly to receive a crown from a figure standing beside them. The background is filled with additional figures dressed in gowns and robes within a richly detailed architectural setting. The scene captures a moment of significance with a focus on the intricate costumes, expressions, and gestures of those present.

artworks.title: Saint Paul, Seated
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 26 × 16.1 cm (10 1/4 × 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man seated on a cloth-draped surface. He has a full beard and long, unkempt hair. He is dressed in a long robe and is barefoot, with one arm resting on an object and the other extended outward. Books are stacked around him, and he holds a pen-like object in one hand while a sword lies beside him. In the background, there are rolling clouds, with figures emerging from the clouds near the bottom of the scene. The area is detailed with etched lines, providing texture to the clouds and landscape.

artworks.title: The Assumption with the Cherubin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 × 4.3 cm (1 15/16 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with a gathering below. The image depicts an ethereal figure surrounded by clouds and smaller figures in the upper part, hovering over a group assembled around a central table below. The celestial figure stands in a majestic pose amidst billowing clouds, and smaller figures are engaged in activities above. Below, a group of figures is gathered around a rectangular table, their attire flowing and classical. The composition is enclosed in an oval frame with shading lines providing depth and texture. The style reflects intricate line work typical of classical or baroque graphic art.

artworks.title: The Small Carrying of the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.6 × 6.7 cm (1 13/16 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with figures involved in a conflict, some on horses and others on foot, with spears and shields. The composition is crowded and intricate, with numerous figures engaged in struggle. The background shows a cityscape, suggesting an urban setting. A small dog is depicted in the foreground. The overall composition is circular, enhancing the sense of action and movement.

artworks.title: Piazza Publicca, Siena
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century (Formerly attributed to Jacques Callot)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.6 × 9.9 cm (3 × 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy square from an elevated point of view. In the center, there is a tall tower, flanked by a building with arches and ornate windows. The detailed drawing uses intricate linework and a monochromatic color palette. People are depicted walking and interacting in the foreground, while buildings shape the urban setting in the distance.

artworks.title: The Attack
artworks.description: The image shows a naval scene with several ships at sea. The horizon line is near the top of the image. There are two ships near the horizon: one labeled "A" to the right and one labeled "B" further away. To the left, there are smaller ships labeled "C" emitting smoke. The etching technique used in this monochrome image provides detailed line work defining the ships, sails, and smoke, creating a historical appearance.

artworks.title: Boarding of the Bertone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.4 × 19.8 cm (6 1/16 × 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated point of view showing water with ships engaged in a sea battle. The horizon is high in the composition with faint land in the distance. In the center, a large sailing ship leans to one side surrounded by smaller vessels. The illustration is detailed with fine lines indicating movement. The style features precise linear strokes defining the ships and the sea. The monochrome palette emphasizes details and creates visual impact. Another ship is seen in the distance near the horizon line.

artworks.title: Boarding of the Petaccio
artworks.description: The image depicts a naval battle with several ships positioned across the sea. The viewpoint is elevated, showing the ships and the vast expanse of the sea. The horizon is high in the composition, with ships in varying distances. Ships in the distance are smaller, creating depth perception. Closer ships, including one in combat with firing cannons, are larger and more detailed. The etching technique shows fine lines and textures, depicting movement in the sea and sails. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black, giving a classic and historical ambiance. The sails and hulls of the ships have detailed linework, adding to the sense of action and drama on the water's surface.

artworks.title: The Prize
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.5 × 20.2 cm (5 11/16 × 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of a naval battle scene with detailed engravings. The horizon is low, blending with the sea. Several ships are engaged in battle, with smoke and cannon blasts indicating the chaos. The sailing ships are intricately detailed with visible planks and rigging. The monochromatic color palette highlights the fine details. The waters are turbulent with seamen visible, and additional ships can be seen in the background. The scene is rich with detail and motion, emphasizing the historical and dramatic aspect of naval warfare.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Varie Figure"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of marketplace activity centered around examining and exchanging items. The detailed line work illustrates a scene where several individuals are gathered around a table laden with small objects. Above them is a sign reading "VARIE FIGVRE DI IACOPO CALLOT." The figures are dressed in historical clothing and the scene conveys a sense of busyness and engagement. The drawing captures human interaction within a historical marketplace setting.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple at Rest
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.4 × 9.6 cm (3 11/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains two individuals depicted in a detailed illustration. One is an elderly man sitting on a rocky surface, with a cane beside him and holding a bottle with his arm extended. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, a tunic, trousers, and boots. The other person is an older woman kneeling or bent down next to him. She wears a bonnet, an overcoat, and a dress, and both individuals carry containers on their backs. In the background, there is a large, gnarled tree with abundant foliage. The setting suggests an outdoor, rugged terrain.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple with Cow
artworks.description: The image has an elevated perspective showing two figures with animals in the scene. One person is leaning against a tree with a stick, while the other is seated on the ground. A cow is between them and other livestock in the middle distance. A person in the distance is tending to the animals. The horizon is low in the image, hidden by rolling hills. The artwork is in monochrome with fine linework, creating texture through hatching and cross-hatching, emphasizing depth and dimensionality.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, Seen from Behind
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.6 × 9.7 cm (3 3/4 × 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women in full-body view, seen from behind, walking side by side. Both women have their arms bent at the elbows, and they appear to be carrying baskets on their left forearms. They are wearing long-sleeved jackets with peplum detail at the waist and long skirts underneath. Their hair is styled in elaborate, curled updos. They stand on a textured surface. In the background are three figures, depicted in similar period clothing, standing and interacting with each other. The overall background is a simple, light-toned surface, emphasizing the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, in Profile, Facing Right
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.5 × 10.4 cm (3 3/4 × 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two identical full-length profile illustrations of a woman standing and facing each other. Both women have one arm outstretched and the other resting on their belly, holding a round basket. They have their hair styled back and up, fine lines defining their facial features. They wear period clothing with long-sleeved peplum blouses, ankle-length gathered skirts, simple shoes, and decorative bows at the end of the sleeves. In the background, there is a social scene with multiple people engaged in various activities such as conversation and dancing outdoors among trees.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket on Head, Front View
artworks.description: The image features two individuals standing side by side. Each person is holding up a basket on their head with one arm and a jug inside the basket. Their other arm rests at their waist. They have curly hair and wear long robes or coats with visible layers underneath, paired with shoes. The background shows a rural setting with two distant figures engaged in agricultural activity, sparse trees, and small buildings.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, in Profile, Facing Left
artworks.description: The image depicts two women standing side by side in profile, facing right. Both are holding baskets in front of them. They have their hair styled up and wear head coverings, long dresses, and aprons. Details of their faces are not shown. In the background are small figures of people, some riding horses, and a building with hanging signs. The scene suggests a street setting with simple line work characteristic of a sketch or etching.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman, in Profile, Facing Right, with Arm Extended
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body portrayals of the same person in profile, facing to the right. The individual is depicted in motion with arms outstretched forward. They have a straight nose, hair styled or covered with a headscarf, and wear a long-sleeved knee-length coat over a draped layered skirt or gown. The individual's shoes are flat with a simple design. In the background, there are cows, some standing and others reclining on the ground, along with sparse foliage and trees.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman, in Profile, Facing Left
artworks.description: Two women are shown in profile, facing each other with their hands in front of them. They have elaborate hairstyles partially covered by headscarves or bonnets. Both women wear long-sleeved dresses with fitted bodices, full skirts, and aprons with small bundles attached. The background features a simple landscape with a few figures in the distance and a tree with bare branches.

artworks.title: Officer, with Arm Extended, Front View
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing side by side. Both are facing forward, with their right arm extended outward and slightly upward. Their faces have pronounced mustaches, and they have curly hair peeking out from under their caps. Each wears a long, buttoned coat with knee-length trousers tucked into boots that rise to just below the knee. The figures are not holding any objects, and the background is a simple, unadorned texture.
